wiki.title: Jody Steverson
wiki.extract: Joseph F. "Jody" Steverson (born August 21, 1968) is a Republican member of the Mississippi House of Representatives, representing the 4th district. Steverson is the Director of Voice and Data for Ripley Video Cable Company. On November 5, 2015, Steverson switched his party affiliation to Republican Party, two days after being reelected unopposed as a Democrat.
